text.p: Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd said it was asking its shareholders to report their holdings in companies belonging to the group due to recent trading activity.

"We have sent out requests for information. We are asking various institutions to disclose their beneficial interest in the group companies and will probably be sending out further requests over the next few days," group corporate secretary Neil McNamara told Reuters on Thursday.
Asked whether the request was related to the Cheung Kong group's acquisition of shares, he said: "There has been a lot of market activity so we thought it was time."
McNamara said the group asked shareholders to disclose their holdings on a regular basis. The last time it requested information from shareholders was in April and before that last December.

"There has been fairly heavy trading in the group's shares over the last two weeks and it has been some months since we sent out the notices so we thought it was time to update our information," he said.
The requests were sent two days ago and Jardine Matheson said results should start coming through on Thursday.

The Jardine Matheson group of companies includes Hongkong Land Holdings Ltd, Jardine Strategic Holdings Ltd, Jardine International Motor Holdings Ltd, Dairy Farm International Holdings Ltd Mandarin Oriental International Ltd, and Cycle & Carriage.
Jardine Matheson said last week that Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and Hutchison Whampoa Ltd together held a 3.03 percent stake in Jardine Matheson and a 3.06 percent stake in Hongkong Land.
